does: Fills a dummy from a root template that has no entity behind it: for a character template it runs the character preparation with no character (visual resource, equipment, speaker), for a light template it adds the light to the scene, for other templates it prepares a visual dummy; then it writes the template's id into the dummy at 0x78 and the template's name into its name. Parameters: the address of a pointer to the entity world, the global resource manager, the level's scene, the dummy, the template.

evidence.says: The template's type (virtual slot 3) selects one of three branches; the tail copies the template's id to the dummy's 0x78 and its name to 0x38. The only caller walks a timeline's actors that have no registered entity and looks each template up in the global template bank.

A probe while a dialog starts records 7 calls, all from the timeline system's function for actors without an entity, with the second argument equal to the value of ls::gGlobalResourceManager and the third equal to the scene at 0x28 of the client level manager's current level.

The template's type (virtual slot 3) selects one of three branches; the tail copies the template's id to the dummy's 0x78 and its name to 0x38. The only caller walks a timeline's actors that have no registered entity and looks each template up in the global template bank.

A probe while a dialog starts records 7 calls, all from the timeline system's function for actors without an entity, with the second argument equal to the value of ls::gGlobalResourceManager and the third equal to the scene at 0x28 of the client level manager's current level. Called for the character root template of Vlaakith on a fresh dummy, the dummy's name reads DUM_Vlaakith, its template field the template's id and its visual resource is set.
EoCClient.dll exports this name; it is tied to this function by the job its read shows
